_comment: Template: Convert reference data (cim/nc classes) into common data as CIM/XML.
_how_to_use: Copy to your working directory. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PATH values. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar ref2common --config this-file.json
_note_rdfFiles: Reference data files (RDF/XML or Turtle); they are merged. They must declare a 'cim' or 'nc' prefix.
_note_output: The CIM/XML file to write, with document-local ids.
